सेंसर बोर्ड ने फिल्म Nakhrewaalii पर चला दी अपनी कैंची! 🎬

30 October को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज हुई Ansh Duggal और Pragati Srivastava की फिल्म Nakhrewaalii को CBFC ने 'A' certificate दिया है।

सेंसर बोर्ड ने फिल्म में कई बड़े बदलाव करवाए हैं। फिल्म में 'Maa ki' शब्द को म्यूट किया गया और सबटाइटल से 'mother' शब्द हटा दिया गया।

इतना ही नहीं, 'UP mein sab poor hote hai kya Sumit' की जगह 'Tumhare yahan sab aise hote hai kya ...' किया गया और 'UP' शब्द को 'village' से बदला गया।

वहीं 'Must be some East Delhi b***h' डायलॉग को 'Must be some cheap little witch' कर दिया गया। इन बदलावों के बाद 28 October को 129.27 मिनट की इस फिल्म को पास किया गया। ✂️

क्या सेंसर बोर्ड का फिल्मों में ऐसे डायलॉग्स पर कट लगाना सही फैसला है? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 💬

ctx.text:
The romantic comedy Nakhrewaalii was released today, October 30, in cinemas. Going by its trailer, the film appeared to be a fun-filled family entertainer with a distinct North Indian flavour, which has almost become a genre of its own in Bollywood. Hence, many moviegoers would be surprised to learn that Nakhrewaalii has been awarded an ‘A’ certificate by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC). This is presumably because the film contains certain scenes deemed suitable only for adult audiences.
Nakhrewalii was passed by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) earlier this week. Despite the adults-only rating, the Examining Committee of the CBFC asked for a few changes. The disclaimer in the beginning was modified. The word 'Maa ki' was muted and the word 'mother' was deleted from the subtitles.
In three places, the CBFC asked for dialogues to be replaced. Accordingly, the dialogue ‘UP mein sab poor hote hai kya Sumit’ was replaced with 'Tumhare yahan sab aise hote hai kya ...'. In another dialogue, 'UP' was replaced with 'village'. Lastly, the line 'Must be some East Delhi b***h' was replaced with 'Must be some cheap little witch'.
Once these changes were made, Nakhrewaalii makers were handed over the censor certificate on October 28. The length of the film, as mentioned on the censor certificate, is 129.27 minutes. In other words, Nakhrewaalii is 2 hours, 9 minutes and 27 seconds.
Nakhrewaalii stars Ansh Duggal and Pragati Srivastava. It tells the story of a misogynistic young man whose love life takes an unexpected turn when the father of the girl he loves challenges him to secure a government job within a month. When he realizes that his only chance of landing the job is to become a woman, he decides to take the plunge. What follows is a series of hilarious situations, confusion and chaos.
